abstract: A 27-year-old woman with grade 3 immature teratoma of the ovary was treated with unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and VAC combination chemotherapy. She received 6 postoperative courses, although initially 12 were planned. Chemotherapy had to be discontinued because of severe bone marrow toxicity. Eighteen months later the patient became pregnant and was ultimately delivered of a normal child. This is the second report of a successful pregnancy following VAC chemotherapy for immature teratoma.
abstract_ja: 27歳の女性がグレード3の未熟卵巣奇形腫を発症し、片側卵管卵巣摘出術およびVAC併用化学療法を受けた。術後の化学療法は予定の12コースではなく6コースを施行したが、重度の骨髄毒性により中止せざるを得なかった。18か月後、患者は妊娠し、最終的に正常な子どもを出産した。VAC化学療法後に妊娠に成功した報告は、今回が2例目である。
